key_insight: SAE-Audit improves black-box LLM predictions of clinical-trial outcomes by supplying auditable, concept-level evidence during inference.
clinical_relevance: More reliable forecasts of trial completion or early termination could support trial planning, though prospective utility is not established.
method: Convert a frozen sparse autoencoder on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct into a vocabulary of clinical concepts.
Fit sparse probes on past trials to identify outcome-associated concepts and their contribution strengths.
Provide protocol-specific concept evidence to a black-box LLM to refine its prediction without additional LLM training.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports balanced-accuracy gains of 9.6–12.0 percentage points for deepseek-v4-flash across five prediction tasks and 8.0 points for GPT-5.6-terra on trial completion.
watch_item: Concept associations are not causal explanations, and the abstract does not specify sample sizes or prospective validation.
paper_title: SAE-Audit: Clinical-Trial Prediction via Inference-Time Optimization of Black-Box LLMs Audited by Sparse Autoencoder Evidence
